messages:
ops-bot: synthetic-check eu-west/canary-21 FAILED — 502 responses x5 in 60s. alert_level=critical. https://monitoring.example.com/alerts/3180012345
PagerDuty: PagerDuty incident PDR-8721 created (triggered by ops-bot). Escalation policy: synth-canaries -> oncall-eng-team. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PDR-8721
Leo Chen: acked PDR-8721. taking first touch. quick check: are other regions affected?
Maria Alvarez: not seeing correlated customer errors in Sentry yet, mostly canary-only for now. checking dashboards.
Samira (oncall): +1 — I'm on rotation, jumping in. Leo do you want me to take over if this looks widespread?
Leo Chen: thanks. quick probe run: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://eu-west.canary.example.com/health` -> returns `502 0.132` consistently for canary host. hitting proxied endpoint.
infra-runner: FYI we just rolled a small nginx update to canary pool ~15m ago in eu-west, rollout id: roll-2026-03-15-12. Could be related.
Maria Alvarez: grabbing recent logs from canary prober: ```
[03/15 12:04:06] probe: request -> backend=proxy-eu-west-1
[03/15 12:04:06] proxy: upstream response=502 "Bad Gateway" from 10.2.14.23:143
[03/15 12:04:07] probe: retry 1/3
[03/15 12:04:08] probe: request -> backend=proxy-eu-west-1
[03/15 12:04:08] proxy: upstream response=502 "Bad Gateway" from 10.2.14.23:143
```
Leo Chen: that upstream ip (10.2.14.23) is one of the new hosts in roll-2026-03-15-12. tagging infra.
Samira (oncall): I'm going to pause the canary prober fanout for eu-west to stop noisy pages — running: `kubectl scale deployment canary-prober --replicas=0 -n infra-eu-west` (will notify when done).
ops-bot: ACTION: canary-prober scaled to 0 replicas in infra-eu-west by Samira (oncall).
PagerDuty: PDR-8721 status: acknowledged by Leo Chen, assigned to oncall-eng-team. Next escalation timer paused.
infra-runner: rolling back roll-2026-03-15-12 on the implicated pool: `kubectl rollout undo rs/proxy-eu-west-1 -n infra-eu-west` — started. will post progress.
Maria Alvarez: customer impact assessment: internal synth only, but some telemetry shows slight rise in 502s for ephemeral internal API; no user-facing 5xxs detected on public routes. marking impact: low/none for customers.
Leo Chen: rollback finished on 3 instances, probes restarted against those hosts: now responses 200. still 2 hosts showing 502, continuing.
Samira (oncall): okay I'm handing off to Leo for remediation and monitoring. I'll update PD and take next rotation handoff in 2 hours if needed.
Leo Chen: will keep monitoring for 30m, will mute further synthetic alerts and close PD if stable. notes added to runbook: https://runbooks.example.com/canary-eu-west-502
PagerDuty: PDR-8721: status changed to resolved by Leo Chen — resolution: rollback of recent nginx rollout removed bad hosts from pool; canary prober noise suppressed.
ops-bot: synthetic-check eu-west/canary-21 RECOVERED — 200 responses. incident thread auto-archived. :white_check_mark:
Samira (oncall): thanks team. followups: add preflight health check to rollout job and add a canary-safety gate. I'll file a short postmortem doc. :memo:
